list: The shop's storage rack is used to hold sewing scissors and what would otherwise be a chaotic mess of thread spools. Usually placed by the workbench for easy access. Tailors must be meticulous—never letting a single loose thread slip by.

This full-length mirror has a platform for clients to stand on when trying new outfits or having their measurements taken. They constantly adjust themselves before it, yet the adornment on top quietly reminds them of who they truly are.

A luxurious display cabinet to match the exquisite garments and high-quality fabrics it holds. If clothes make the man, then fabric makes the clothes. Here, clients can select their preferred materials and plan their ideal look.

A unique stool with spiral legs, said to be inspired by tightly twisted jute rope. As a child, Luchino would climb onto this stool to watch his grandfather work. Perhaps it was then that he began learning the art of tailoring.

A common Siracusan plant, in an equally common pot, yet it always seems to catch the attention of detectives and police officers. 'What's the deal? We're an honest tailor shop—there aren't any secret messages or ledgers hidden under it!'

A small coffee table typical of tailor shop reception areas, where clients are served their favorite refreshments. Tailoring involves many decisions—no need to rush the process. Sit back, have a drink, and take your time to decide!

Wallpaper preserving the wood grain pattern. A more traditional Siracusan-style, unlike the easily washable walls found in famiglia strongholds. The blood-soaked chaos of the streets does not intrude into one's home—a tacit understanding.
Flooring designed to imitate the hardwood style of the tailor shop, complete with the polished sheen of real wooden planks. Keeping the floor spotless is a point of pride for the shop's apprentices.
Order, as defined by different people.
theme: A recreation based on Figurino's description of a tailor shop specializing in custom, classic Siracusan suits. Respectable attire is essential for everyone, whether a big shot from a prominent famiglia or just an ordinary citizen.
